official_source_url.value: https://sudanembassy.org/entry-visa/ — Embassy of the Republic of Sudan confirms the entry visa application requires "One (1) passport sized photo attached with the application form." Quantity (1 photo) is confirmed; exact dimensions, background colour, and format are not specified on this page. The embassy's official Form No.7 (Ministry of Interior, Passport & Immigration General Administration) application form itself contains no photo box dimension text either.
